name: list_vaults
description: List open vaults and their IDs for use with vault_id.

name: list_pages
description: List all pages: id, title, revision, createdAt, updatedAt. No block contents.

vault_id.description: Vault ID from list_vaults. Required when more than one vault is open.

name: get_page
description: Get a full page by id: title, current revision and all blocks in display order (markdown sources and mermaid, BPMN or draw.io diagrams).

vault_id.description: Vault ID from list_vaults. Required when more than one vault is open.

page_id.description: Vault: root-relative document path with extension; SQLite: page ID

name: add_page
description: Create a new empty page and return its id and revision. Use request_id for safe retries.

vault_id.description: Vault ID from list_vaults. Required when more than one vault is open.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key; repeating the call with the same key returns the stored result instead of duplicating it

name: write_markdown
description: Create or fully replace a markdown block. On a conflict nothing changes — read the page again and retry with the fresh revision.

vault_id.description: Vault ID from list_vaults. Required when more than one vault is open.

page_id.description: Vault: root-relative document path with extension; SQLite: page ID

block_id.description: Vault: transient span ID from the current revision, must exist. Omit to insert at at/EOF. SQLite: stable block ID

expected_revision.description: Page revision the caller has seen; mismatch -> conflict error with details.currentRevision

source.description: Markdown source of the block (plain text)

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key; repeating the call with the same key returns the stored result instead of duplicating it

name: write_diagram
description: Create or fully replace a diagram block (mermaid, bpmn or drawio). source is CLEAN Mermaid WITHOUT ``` fences, a BPMN 2.0 XML document OR draw.io mxfile/mxGraphModel XML. On a syntax error the new version is NOT saved (page revision unchanged) — fix source per validation.error.message and retry. For BPMN without BPMNDI geometry pass layout: "auto" (or publish first and call layout_diagram later). BPMN lint findings (validation.lint) do NOT block publishing, but you should address them. For complex diagrams: publish a minimal correct version first, then refine it with successive meaningful updates — the user sees changes in real time; do not postpone publishing until the end of your work.

vault_id.description: Vault ID from list_vaults. Required when more than one vault is open.

page_id.description: Vault: root-relative document path with extension; SQLite: page ID

block_id.description: Vault: transient span ID from the current revision, must exist. Omit to insert at at/EOF. SQLite: stable block ID

expected_revision.description: Page revision the caller has seen; mismatch -> conflict error with details.currentRevision

source.description: Diagram source: clean Mermaid without ```mermaid fences, BPMN 2.0 XML or draw.io mxfile/mxGraphModel XML

layout.description: BPMN layout mode: preserve (use geometry from XML, fails without BPMNDI) or auto (recalculate layout; manual positions may change)

title.description: Optional diagram title displayed ABOVE the diagram as an HTML heading (it is NOT part of the SVG). Omit to keep the existing title; pass an empty string to remove it.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key; repeating the call with the same key returns the stored result instead of duplicating it

name: check_diagram
description: Validate a diagram block. mode 'syntax' (default) runs parsing only: mermaid.parse for mermaid blocks, BPMN 2.0 XML parsing + bpmnlint for bpmn blocks (findings in validation.lint), draw.io XML parsing for drawio blocks; mode 'render' fully renders (mermaid, bpmn-js or the local draw.io editor) and returns the validation result only — no image is attached (agents should not try to view it; a human can get a PNG via REST /pages/:pageId/blocks/:blockId/png). The service picks the checks by block type. If the passed revision is outdated, the check is skipped (stale=true) — re-read the page first.

vault_id.description: Vault ID from list_vaults. Required when more than one vault is open.

page_id.description: Vault: root-relative document path with extension; SQLite: page ID

revision.description: Expected current page revision; if it differs from the actual one, the check is skipped (stale=true)

name: layout_diagram
description: Recalculate the BPMN diagram layout (bpmn-auto-layout) and publish it as a new revision. Only for bpmn blocks.

expected_revision.description: Page revision the caller has seen; mismatch -> conflict error with details.currentRevision

block_order.description: New display order: array of block ids, exactly the blocks remaining on the page
